message.content:
So the flow is: `interpret_maker_note` is called, which gets the MAKER_NOTE entry `e`, and calls `exif_mnote_data_apple_identify(data, e)`. The apple identify does `strcmp((const char *) e->data, "Apple iOS")` without checking `e->size`.

The `e->data` is the maker note data. If the maker note data is not NUL-terminated (i.e., doesn't contain a NUL byte within its size), `strcmp` will read out of bounds.
